description-zh: Ruby程序的入口函数示例，包含命令行参数处理和异常处理
description-en: Entry point function example for Ruby programs, including command line arguments and exception handling
code:
#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'optparse'

# 主程序类
class Main
  def initialize
    @options = {}
  end

  def parse_options(args)
    OptionParser.new do |opts|
      opts.banner = "Usage: #{$PROGRAM_NAME} [options]"

      opts.on("-n", "--name NAME", "Name to greet") do |name|
        @options[:name] = name
      end

      opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help message") do
        puts opts
        exit
      end
    end.parse!(args)
  end

  def run(args = ARGV)
    # 解析命令行参数
    parse_options(args)
    
    # 打印程序信息
    puts "Program: #{$PROGRAM_NAME}"
    
    # 打印命令行参数
    puts "Arguments count: #{args.length}"
    puts "Arguments: #{args.inspect}"
    
    # 程序主要逻辑
    name = @options[:name] || 'World'
    puts "Hello, #{name}!"
    
    return 0
  rescue StandardError => e
    warn "Error: #{e.message}"
    warn e.backtrace if $DEBUG
    return 1
  end
end

# 如果是直接运行此文件
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  exit Main.new.run
end

require 'net/http'
require 'uri'

def http_get(url, timeout = 5)
  uri = URI.parse(url)
  http = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == 'https', open_timeout: timeout, read_timeout: timeout)
  req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
  res = http.request(req)

rescue StandardError

end

description-zh: 递归地将 Hash 的字符串键转为符号键
description-en: Recursively symbolize string keys in Hash
code:
def symbolize_keys(obj)
  case obj
  when Array
    obj.map { |v| symbolize_keys(v) }
  when Hash
    obj.each_with_object({}) do |(k,v), h|
      key = k.is_a?(String) ? k.to_sym : k
      h[key] = symbolize_keys(v)
    end
  else
    obj
  end
end

def deep_merge(a, b)
  a.merge(b) do |_k, v1, v2|
    v1.is_a?(Hash) && v2.is_a?(Hash) ? deep_merge(v1, v2) : v2
  end
end

def slugify(s)
  s.to_s.downcase
    .gsub(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/i, '')
    .strip
    .gsub(/\s+/, '-')
    .gsub(/-+/, '-')
end

code:
require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'json'

def http_post_json(url, obj, timeout = 5)
  uri = URI.parse(url)
  req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
  req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
  req.body = JSON.dump(obj)
  http = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == 'https', open_timeout: timeout, read_timeout: timeout)
  res = http.request(req)
  res.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess) ? res.body : nil
rescue StandardError
  nil
end

description-zh: 在非负权图上使用优先队列(简化实现)求单源最短路
description-en: Single-source shortest path on non-negative graph using a simple priority queue
code:
# adj[u] = [[v, w], ...]; 0 <= u < n
# 简易小根堆: 用数组排序替代
def dijkstra(n, adj, src)
  inf = 1 << 60
  dist = Array.new(n, inf)
  dist[src] = 0
  heap = [[0, src]] # [d, u]
  until heap.empty?
    heap.sort_by! { |x| x[0] }
    d, u = heap.shift
    next if d != dist[u]
    adj[u].each do |v, w|
      nd = d + w
      if nd < dist[v]
        dist[v] = nd
        heap << [nd, v]
      end
    end
  end
  dist
end

description-zh: 允许负边权的单源最短路；检测负环
description-en: Single-source shortest path with negative edges; detect negative cycles
code:
# edges: [[u,v,w], ...]
def bellman_ford(n, edges, src)
  inf = (1<<60)
  dist = Array.new(n, inf)
  dist[src] = 0
  (n-1).times do
    updated = false
    edges.each do |u,v,w|
      next if dist[u] >= inf
      if dist[u] + w < dist[v]
        dist[v] = dist[u] + w
        updated = true
      end
    end
    break unless updated
  end
  edges.each do |u,v,w|
    next if dist[u] >= inf
    return [dist, true] if dist[u] + w < dist[v]
  end
  [dist, false]
end

description-zh: 入度法Kahn算法返回拓扑序列
description-en: Kahn algorithm using indegrees to return topo order
code:
def topo_sort_kahn(n, adj)
  indeg = Array.new(n, 0)
  0.upto(n-1) { |u| adj[u].each { |v| indeg[v]+=1 } }
  q = []
  0.upto(n-1) { |i| q << i if indeg[i] == 0 }
  order = []
  head = 0
  while head < q.length
    u = q[head]; head += 1
    order << u
    adj[u].each do |v|
      indeg[v] -= 1
      q << v if indeg[v] == 0
    end
  end
  order
end

description-zh: 返回所有匹配起始下标
description-en: Return all match start indices
code:
def kmp_search(text, pat)
  n = text.length; m = pat.length
  return [] if m == 0
  lps = Array.new(m, 0)
  i = 1; len = 0
  while i < m
    if pat[i] == pat[len]
      len += 1; lps[i] = len; i += 1
    elsif len > 0
      len = lps[len-1]
    else
      lps[i] = 0; i += 1
    end
  end
  res = []
  i = 0; j = 0
  while i < n
    if text[i] == pat[j]
      i += 1; j += 1
      if j == m
        res << (i - m)
        j = lps[j-1]
      end
    elsif j > 0
      j = lps[j-1]
    else
      i += 1
    end
  end
  res
end

description-zh: 滚动哈希匹配，返回所有位置
description-en: Rolling-hash matching, return all indices
code:
def rabin_karp(text, pat)
  n = text.length; m = pat.length
  return [] if m == 0 || m > n
  base = 131
  mod = 1_000_000_007
  powb = 1
  (m-1).times { powb = (powb * base) % mod }
  hpat = 0; hwin = 0
  0.upto(m-1) do |i|
    hpat = (hpat * base + pat.getbyte(i)) % mod
    hwin = (hwin * base + text.getbyte(i)) % mod
  end
  out = []
  0.upto(n - m) do |i|
    if hpat == hwin && text[i, m] == pat
      out << i
    end
    if i < n - m
      hwin = (hwin - text.getbyte(i) * powb) % mod
      hwin += mod if hwin < 0
      hwin = (hwin * base + text.getbyte(i + m)) % mod
    end
  end
  out
end

description-zh: 在[2,n]内标记素数
description-en: Mark primes in [2,n]
code:
def sieve_is_prime(n)
  is_prime = Array.new(n+1, true)
  is_prime[0] = false if n >= 0
  is_prime[1] = false if n >= 1
  p = 2
  while p * p <= n
    if is_prime[p]
      x = p * p
      while x <= n
        is_prime[x] = false
        x += p
      end
    end
    p += 1
  end
  is_prime
end

description-zh: 动态规划计算编辑距离(滚动数组)
description-en: DP edit distance with rolling array
code:
def edit_distance(a, b)
  m = a.length; n = b.length
  prev = (0..n).to_a
  cur = Array.new(n+1, 0)
  (1..m).each do |i|
    cur[0] = i
    ai = a.getbyte(i-1)
    (1..n).each do |j|
      cost = (ai == b.getbyte(j-1)) ? 0 : 1
      del = prev[j] + 1
      ins = cur[j-1] + 1
      rep = prev[j-1] + cost
      cur[j] = [del, ins, rep].min
    end
    prev, cur = cur, prev
  end
  prev[n]
end

name-zh: 最长上升子序列O(n log n)
description-zh: 耐心排序+二分求LIS长度
description-en: Patience sorting + binary search for LIS length
code:
def lis_length(a)
  tails = []
  a.each do |x|
    # 下界二分找到第一个 >= x 的位置
    l = 0; r = tails.length
    while l < r
      m = (l + r) / 2
      if tails[m] >= x
        r = m
      else
        l = m + 1
      end
    end
    if l == tails.length
      tails << x
    else
      tails[l] = x
    end
  end
  tails.length
end

description-zh: 平均线性时间找到第k小(1<=k<=n)
description-en: Find k-th smallest in average linear time (1<=k<=n)
code:
def quickselect(a, k) # k: 1-based
  l = 0; r = a.length - 1; k -= 1
  while l <= r
    pivot = a[r]
    i = l
    (l...r).each do |j|
      if a[j] <= pivot
        a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
        i += 1
      end
    end
    a[i], a[r] = a[r], a[i]
    if i == k
      return a[i]
    elsif i > k
      r = i - 1
    else
      l = i + 1
    end
  end
  raise ArgumentError, 'k out of range'
end
